standard-dialogue-before-putting-evil-bo.text: If the player has not talked to the Servant previously:

steps.player: I need help, I've been kidnapped by an evil cat!

steps.npc: Meow! Errr... I c-c-c-can't help you... He'll kill us all!

steps.player: Now you listen to me! He's just a little cat! There must be something I can do!

steps.npc: F-f-f-fish... give him the f-f-f-fish he likes and he might f- f-f-fall asleep.
Look... over t-t-there! That fishing spot c-c-contains the f-f-f-fish he likes.

steps.text: A cutscene starts, showing where to catch the fish that Evil Bob likes.

standard-dialogue-before-putting-evil-bo.text: If the player has already talked to the Servant:

steps.npc: F-f-f-fish... give him the f-f-f-fish he likes and he might f- f-f-fall asleep.

standard-dialogue-after-putting-evil-bob.player: Evil Bob has fallen asleep, come quickly!
Away from this place! To Gielinor!

standard-dialogue-after-putting-evil-bob.npc: You go, [player name], I don't belong there... I belong here, in ScapeRune. This is the only place I can ever go...

steps.npc: Our love can never be, sweet [player name].
Go now! Go, and don't look back!

steps.player: Oh, alright then, I'll be off! See you around!

male-servant-historical-before-putting-e.text: If the player has not talked to the Servant previously:

steps.player: I just want to talk to you, that's all.

steps.npc: No, he's insane! He'll kill us all! Like he killed the others!

male-servant-historical-before-putting-e.text: If the player has already talked to the Servant:

male-servant-historical-after-putting-ev.player: Evil Bob is sleeping! You can escape!

male-servant-historical-after-putting-ev.npc: No, Evil Bob will track us down eventually and when he does...
No, I dare not leave this place.
